name: Invoice Processor
purpose: Automatically extracts, validates, and processes invoices
description: End-to-end invoice automation: captures invoice data via OCR, matches against POs, routes for approval, and syncs to accounting.
instructions: Automatically extracts line items from uploaded invoices using OCR, matches them against purchase orders in your ERP, and routes for approval based on configurable thresholds. Flags discrepancies for human review and syncs finalized entries to accounting.

name: CRM Sync Agent
purpose: Keeps customer data synchronized across CRM, email, support, and billing
description: Bi-directional sync agent that ensures contacts, companies, deals, and activities stay consistent across Salesforce, HubSpot, and connected tools.
instructions: Bi-directionally syncs contacts, deals, and activities between connected CRM platforms. Detects duplicates, enriches records with external data, and ensures data consistency across Salesforce, HubSpot, and integrated tools.

name: Email Assistant
purpose: Drafts, categorizes, and routes emails with context-aware responses
description: AI-powered email triage that reads incoming messages, categorizes urgency, drafts replies, and routes to the right team member.
instructions: Reads incoming emails across connected inboxes, categorizes urgency using AI, drafts context-aware responses, and routes messages to the appropriate team member. Integrates with Slack for real-time notifications on high-priority items.

name: Data Entry Bot
purpose: Automates repetitive data entry across spreadsheets, forms, and databases
description: Reads from emails, PDFs, and forms, then enters structured data into Google Sheets, Airtable, databases, and CRMs with validation.
instructions: Automates repetitive data entry by reading from emails, PDFs, and web forms, then entering structured data into Google Sheets, Airtable, databases, and CRMs with validation. Handles bulk processing with error flagging for manual review.

name: Inventory Tracker
purpose: Monitors stock levels, predicts reorder points, and syncs across systems
description: Real-time inventory monitoring with predictive reorder recommendations. Syncs NetSuite, Shopify, and Zoho inventory counts.
instructions: Monitors stock levels in real time across NetSuite, Shopify, and Zoho, predicts reorder points using demand forecasting, and automatically generates purchase orders when thresholds are reached. Syncs counts across all sales channels.

name: Compliance Auditor
purpose: Scans systems for compliance violations and generates audit trails
description: Automated compliance scanning across Jira, ServiceNow, and document repositories. Flags HIPAA, SOC2, and GDPR violations with severity ratings.
instructions: Scans connected systems (Jira, ServiceNow, document repositories) for compliance violations against HIPAA, SOC2, and GDPR frameworks. Generates detailed audit trails, flags violations with severity ratings, and tracks remediation progress.

name: HR Onboarding Agent
purpose: Automates new hire paperwork, system provisioning, and orientation scheduling
description: End-to-end employee onboarding: sends offer letters, collects e-signatures, provisions accounts in BambooHR/Workday, schedules orientation.
instructions: Automates end-to-end employee onboarding: sends personalized offer letters, collects e-signatures via DocuSign, provisions accounts in BambooHR/Workday, schedules orientation sessions, and runs compliance background checks.

name: Social Media Manager
purpose: Schedules posts, analyzes engagement, and generates content across platforms
description: Multi-platform social media management: drafts posts, schedules across LinkedIn/Meta/Hootsuite, analyzes engagement metrics.
instructions: Drafts platform-optimized posts, schedules content across LinkedIn, Meta, and Hootsuite, analyzes engagement metrics, and recommends hashtag strategies. Provides weekly competitor analysis and content performance reports.

name: Route Optimizer
purpose: Optimizes delivery routes for time, fuel, and cost efficiency
description: Real-time route optimization using Google Maps and Onfleet. Factors traffic, weather, delivery windows, and vehicle capacity.
instructions: Optimizes delivery routes in real time using Google Maps and Onfleet data, factoring in traffic conditions, weather, delivery time windows, and vehicle capacity. Reduces fuel costs and improves on-time delivery rates across your fleet.

name: Production Scheduler
purpose: Sequences work orders and optimizes production line throughput
description: Intelligent production scheduling that sequences work orders by priority, material availability, and machine capacity. Integrates with SAP and Monday.com.
instructions: Sequences manufacturing work orders by priority, material availability, and machine capacity. Integrates with SAP and Monday.com to detect bottlenecks, balance production lines, and automatically reschedule when disruptions occur.

name: Support Triage Agent
purpose: Categorizes, prioritizes, and routes support tickets to the right team
description: AI-powered ticket triage: reads incoming Zendesk/Intercom tickets, categorizes by urgency and topic, suggests responses, and routes to specialized agents.
instructions: Reads incoming Zendesk and Intercom tickets, categorizes by urgency and topic using NLP, suggests response templates, and routes to the best-available support agent based on skills and current workload. Monitors SLA compliance in real time.

name: Lead Scoring Agent
purpose: Scores and prioritizes leads based on behavior, demographics, and engagement
description: ML-powered lead scoring across Salesforce, HubSpot, and Marketo. Prioritizes leads by conversion likelihood and recommends next actions.
instructions: Scores and prioritizes leads using machine learning across Salesforce, HubSpot, and Marketo. Analyzes behavioral signals, demographic fit, and engagement history to rank leads by conversion likelihood and recommend next-best actions.

name: Customer Onboarding Agent
purpose: Guides new customers through setup, training, and first-value milestones
description: Automated customer onboarding: sends welcome sequences, schedules training, tracks product adoption, and escalates at-risk accounts.
instructions: Guides new customers through setup with automated welcome sequences, schedules personalized training sessions, tracks product adoption milestones, and escalates at-risk accounts to CSMs based on health scoring triggers.

name: Support Ticket Router
purpose: Intelligently routes support tickets based on content, customer tier, and agent availability
description: Smart ticket routing engine that reads ticket content, checks customer tier, agent skills, and current workload to route optimally.
instructions: Intelligently routes support tickets based on content analysis, customer tier, agent skills, and current workload. Ensures high-priority enterprise customers get immediate attention while balancing overall team capacity.

name: Sales Follow-Up Agent
purpose: Automates multi-channel follow-up sequences for leads and opportunities
description: Multi-channel follow-up automation across email, phone, and LinkedIn. Sequences adapt based on prospect engagement signals.
instructions: Automates multi-channel follow-up sequences across email, phone, and LinkedIn. Adapts timing and messaging based on prospect engagement signals, personalizes templates, and logs all activity back to your CRM automatically.

name: PO Management Agent
purpose: Automates purchase order creation, approval routing, and vendor matching
description: End-to-end PO automation: generates POs from requisitions, routes for approval based on spend limits, matches against vendor catalogs in SAP Ariba/Coupa.
instructions: Generates purchase orders from approved requisitions, routes for approval based on configurable spend limits, matches line items against vendor catalogs in SAP Ariba/Coupa, and syncs finalized POs to your ERP system.

name: Payroll Reconciliation Agent
purpose: Reconciles timesheets, benefits, and payroll data across systems
description: Automated payroll reconciliation: cross-references ADP/Gusto timesheets against HR records, flags discrepancies, generates adjustment reports.
instructions: Cross-references ADP/Gusto timesheets against HR records, verifies benefits deductions, flags discrepancies between payroll runs, and generates adjustment reports for finance review before each pay period closes.
